name: driving-safety-gate-handler
reason: PR #165 gate on screen/HUD writes while moving. Upstream deleted theirs; see yash-srivastava/Overdrive-release#233.

name: driving-safety-gate-outcome
reason: Both gated call sites must still return the blocked_driving outcome. Scoped to the single handler file that owns the gate -- a broader glob would let an unrelated file's stray mention of the string satisfy this.

name: driving-safety-gate-strings
reason: The user-facing half of the PR #165 gate: what a client is told when an action is refused because the car is moving. Upstream deleted the key from its catalogues, and the locale merge policy (theirs-deleted + ours-unchanged -> drop) then removes it from every locale we never edited -- no conflict, no clash entry, no error. A live end-to-end sync took it from 32 catalogues to 15 and still reported 'invariants: pass', because this entry is in the spec's invariants table but never reached the manifest; R6 had meanwhile moved server-i18n INTO sync scope, turning it from a redundant tripwire into the only guard. 32 of the 33 server-i18n catalogues carry the key (en.json falls back to the code default), so any total below 32 means the sync ate translations. code_only is false: the needle is a JSON key, a string literal by construction -- it still can never match inside a comment.

name: credential-cipher-salt
reason: MUST-PRESERVE: changing KD_SALT breaks every stored credential.

name: backup-bundle-format
reason: MUST-PRESERVE: changing BUNDLE_FORMAT breaks existing config backups.

name: exclusivity-preflight-old-package
reason: Detects a running com.overdrive.app install so the two apps can coexist. The normalize transform must not rewrite it. The needle is the string-literal package name itself, so code_only is false -- it still can never match inside a comment.

name: update-repo-points-at-wheelstop
reason: The auto-updater must never be re-pointed at upstream releases. The needle is the string-literal repo slug itself, so code_only is false -- it still can never match inside a comment.
